rounds.notes:
### ⚔️ ITEMS

In Round 2, I suggest going for [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power), [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) and **Survivability**. A good [Mercy](hero_0e213bfc-3ca9-49c6-9036-e7f344b752da) **must** stay alive.

#### 🔹 Over $15k?
 [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) is an amazing item for Round 2 if you got enough cash to pair it with a survivability item. If you are not getting targeted, you can get more [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) or [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed).


| Item | Description |
| ---- | ------------ |
| [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) | Boosts your Staff's Healing by **30%** on critical health allies, assuring their survival |
| [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) | Increased Survivability 🛡️ (damage reduction from armor)  |
| [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) | Increased **Healing** (15%) |
| [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) | Increased **Healing** (15%) |
| [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) | Increased **Healing** (10%) and [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) (5%) |
| [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) | Increased Healing (10%) and [Move Speed](stat_move_speed) (5%) |

### 💫 POWERS

[The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) 
- This Power is the **core** of this build. This allows you to **burst heal**, and **damage boost** much more often, since you have another source of healing. Make sure to get the mandatory items listed below.

### ⚔️ ITEMS

#### ⚠️ Make sure to get the items marked with ✨ first, then choose between the other items listed below depending on your remaining cash or different matchups.
[Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) and [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) are mandatory. 

####  

#### 🔹IF YOU HAVE $32k
If you have $11k left after buying [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) and [Mark of the Kitsune], I suggest [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8). Otherwise, I suggest either some survivability such as [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) or [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0), or some extra [Ability Power](stat_ability_power).

| ---- | ------------ |
| [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) | ✨ Insane Survivability + [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) (synergizes with [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) and [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb)) |
